commit.message: * some missing size_t(0) casts for compilation

8392855

Hi all,

  please review this fix for usage of the `G1LastPLABAverageOccupancy` flag; it allows giving the PLABs extra headroom/amplification for very noisy workloads to keep PLAB sizes high.

Unfortunately, after the inversion of the meaning of that flag in JDK-8315765 the allowed bounds were not inverted as well, allowing a division by zero in the calculation. Further, the amplification could cause overflow in the desired PLAB statistic, potentially causing performance issues.

The change fixes that by capping the amplification to allow at most TargetPLABWastePct wastage, which seems better than any other artificial value.

Testing: gtest, gha

Thanks,
  Thomas
